content_data.meeting_title: Strategic Portfolio Review and Market Expansion Planning Session
agenda_items: Market expansion strategy for telehealth services
Supply chain optimization initiatives and cost reduction targets
Competitive landscape assessment in biosimilars market
key_decisions: Postponed launch of biosimilar product line pending additional regulatory guidance expected within 6 months
Authorized formation of cross-functional task force to address supply chain vulnerabilities identified in recent risk assessment
action_items: Marcus Chen to coordinate with Legal and Regulatory Affairs on updated compliance framework by month-end
Fatima Al-Rashid to develop comprehensive supply chain resilience plan with mitigation strategies within 45 days
Olivia Nkrumah to schedule follow-up session with Board of Directors to review strategic priorities within 6 weeks
